title: Compact per-route cost-sparkline and fat-tail latency explainer panel
author: Maya Patel
description:
Motivation: Production SREs and customers asked for a compact dashboard widget that surfaces per-route and per-tenant cost signal trends alongside an explainability view for fat-tail latency/cost spikes. Large existing dashboards are useful for deep-dive but too noisy for paging UIs and small consoles. This PR introduces a lightweight 'cost-sparkline' panel plus a correlated 'fat-tail latency explainer' widget that links sampled traces and derived root-cause labels.

What changed (high level): Added derived metrics and dashboard assets, light-weight trace-tag propagation for sampled traces, and instrumented a tail-cause derivation that tags spans with a categorical label (kv_cache_miss|large_request|quant_tier|model_fallback). The UI panel shows a compact 7-day sparkline with min/median/p95/p99 overlaid and a small inline attribution summary (percent of tail events attributed to each cause). The explainer panel surfaces a sampled trace list and a heatmap correlating request size, kv cache hit rate, and quantization tier with tail latency.

Files and areas touched: telemetry/metrics/derived_cost.py (new): derives telemetry.cost_sparkline and telemetry.tail_cause_score; observability/grafana/panels/cost_sparkline.json (new): compact panel with sparkline + attribution summary; observability/grafana/panels/tail_explainer.json (new): explainer panel referencing trace links; otel/propagation/fast-sampling-propagator.patch: small change to attach sample tags for lightweight back-linking; tests/test_cost_sparkline.py: unit and integration snapshot tests; docs/observability/README.md: usage and dashboard placement guidance.

Commits summary: - 7 commits, squashed on merge. Key commits: 1) derive: add cost_sparkline and tail_cause_score metrics (unit-tested) 2) ui: add compact sparkline and explainer dashboard panels 3) infra: propagate sampling tags into trace headers 4) tests: dashboard snapshot + integration fixture for synthetic tenant workloads 5) docs: observability guidance and alert tuning notes.

Compatibility and performance: The derived metrics are computed in the metrics ingestion pipeline as a lightweight aggregation (rolling 1h->7d rollup); they add a small CPU footprint (benchmarked at ~0.4% additional CPU on ingestion workers for our internal test load). The trace propagation change is opt-in behind a feature toggle (observability.experimental.lightweight_tail_links) to avoid increasing cardinality by default.

Alerting and SLO ties: Updated rule suggestions in docs to use the new sparkline as a compact signal for oncall pages. Added guidance to switch from strict p99 thresholding to a probabilistic alert that combines p95 drift + tail attribution weight so teams only page when tail composition shifts toward KV misses or model fallback.

Testing and rollout: Unit tests added for metric derivation and attribution edge cases. Dashboard snapshots validated in CI (grafana-lint + JSON schema). Staged rollout: feature toggle off by default, enabled for internal dev orgs for 48h smoke, then ramped to staging tenants.

Backwards compatibility: No breaking API changes. Dashboard JSON is additive. Feature is off by default to prevent noisy signals for customers with high-cardinality labels.

Related: ENG-1998 (drive adoption of compact observability panels), SUP-721 (customer report about opaque cost spikes).
commits: 7 commits (squashed on merge): derive cost_sparkline & tail_cause_score; add compact panels; sampling tag propagation; tests and docs
review_conversation: Evan Brooks (reviewer): Nice compact panel design; please double-check cardinality of new labels and ensure we aggregate by tenant_id to avoid high-cardinality blowup.
Maya Patel (author): Good catch — added aggregation by tenant_id and introduced a feature toggle to gate the sampling tags. See telemetry/metrics/derived_cost.py where we limit tag expansion.
Sofia Ortega (reviewer): Can we ensure behavior when KV cache is disabled (on-prem deployments)? Need a safe fallback for attribution scoring.
Maya Patel (author): Added unit test for kv cache disabled case and fallback to 'unknown_cache_state' label; documented behavior in README.
Ravi Kapoor (reviewer): Integration tests look good; one request: add a short blurb in release notes about oncall implications and suggested threshold defaults.
Maya Patel (author): Added release notes and default threshold guidance in docs and alert rule comments.
CI Bot: dashboard-snapshot validation initially failed due to a missing panel uid; fixed in commit 4 and re-ran — all checks passed.
Evan Brooks (approval): LGTM after the cardinality guard and kv-cache fallback. Approving for squash-merge.
release_notes: Added a compact per-route cost-sparkline panel and a fat-tail latency explainer to help teams quickly surface and diagnose cost/latency spikes. Feature is behind a toggle and off by default. Suggested alert tuning guidance included in docs.
